description: Eli Lilly is the powerhouse behind today’s blockbuster drugs Mounjaro (tirzepatide), prescribed for weight loss; erectile-dysfunction treatment Cialis (tadalafil); Humalog, a rapid-acting insulin; and diabetes treatment Trulicity. Founded in 1876 by Civil War veteran Eli Lilly, it was the first to mass-produce insulin in the 1920s, one of the first to mass-produce penicillin during World War II, and an early producer of the polio vaccine. The company has also developed several major mental-health drugs, including Prozac (fluoxetine), one of the most widely prescribed selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors in the world. Eli Lilly operates in over 100 countries.

rankings.title: Change the World
rankings.itemDescription: Pharmaceutical company Eli Lilly is known for breaking ground in insulin, polio vaccines, penicillin, and antidepressants, most famously developing Prozac. Now, in the age of GLP-1 medications, which have transformed obesity and diabetes treatment, the company has shown it can move fast. Eli Lilly brought tirzepatide (sold as Mounjaro and Zepbound) from clinic to market in six years, compared with the company’s usual 11-year development cycles. An ongoing battle for Lilly, as well as Novo Nordisk, involves fighting copycat versions of its GLP-1 products made by compounders, and forcing them to modify their disputed claims. The FDA has warned patients and health care professionals about the dangers of compounded GLP-1 drugs and unapproved weight-loss medicine.

rankings.title: Fortune 500
rankings.itemDescription: Eli Lilly, the Indiana-based pharma company, is celebrating its 150th anniversary in grand style: Its revenues have tripled since 2018, to $65.2 billion last year. It owes its surge to Mounjaro (for diabetes) and Zepbound (for weight management), which together command about 60% of the manically growing U.S. market for GLP-1 drugs.

rankings.title: Fortune 100 Best Companies To Work For – Europe
rankings.itemDescription: Founded over 145 years ago in Indianapolis, pharmaceutical company Eli Lilly established its first European affiliate in 1934. Lilly has provided more than two million doses of diabetes and cancer medicines to hospitals and patients in Ukraine via humanitarian partners, and its Foundation aims to extend Lilly's reach and impact and support programs that align with its philanthropic priorities. The pharma company's Skills First approach gives individuals without four-year degrees access to job opportunities that may not be available through traditional recruiting practices; apprentices receive a combination of formal training, on-the-job learning and mentoring in a key functional area to equip them for a full-time role.

rankings.title: Fortune 500
rankings.itemDescription: The pharmaceutical giant was founded in Indianapolis in 1876. It introduced the world's first commercially available insulin product, Iletin, in 1923 for the treatment of diabetes. It was also the first company to manufacture and globally distribute Jonas Salk's polio vaccine. Today Lilly is known best for clinical depression drugs Prozac (1986) and Cymbalta (2004) and antipsychotic medication Zyprexa (1996), though its biggest revenue drivers are diabetes drugs Trulicity (2014) and Humalog (1996). Still headquartered in Indiana's capital city, the company made its largest acquisition ever in 2019 when it purchased Stamford, Conn.'s Loxo Oncology for $8 billion.
